name: Other sensors
summary: Sensors for temperature, pressure, humidity, flow, gas, weight and position.
identify: Thermistors on wires in fridges, kettles and battery packs; pressure switches on pumps and boilers; humidity sensors in weather stations; load cells in scales; encoders on motors and knobs; gas sensors in CO and gas alarms.
test: A thermistor’s resistance changes as your fingers warm it. Others are easiest to test powered in their own device.

decay.note: Lasts; CO and gas sensors wear out after 5–10 years.
